subject: Steenbergen rewrites the record books in prelims
preheader: Plus Pan Pacs is loading up, a 13-year-old stuns Utah, and your Monday threshold set.
heroHeading: Good morning swimmers and happy Monday
heroTeaser: Marrit Steenbergen walked into European Championships prelims and walked out with a continental record — and the week is just getting started.
outroLine: That's the week in the water. Happy swimming,

workout.dateLabel: Mon, Aug 10 · distance freestyle threshold in the pool, oblique rotation core on land

swimSet.title: Today's Swim Set
swimSet.description: A 3,000-yard descending threshold freestyle set where you lock in your stroke count early and push each block to a pace that is genuinely uncomfortable by the final rep.

lift.title: Today's Lift
lift.description: An oblique-led rotation and anti-extension core session targeting the stability demands of freestyle and backstroke.

newsItems.title: Steenbergen breaks Euros 100 free record — in prelims
newsItems.body: Marrit Steenbergen clocked a 52.62 in the 100 freestyle to shave 0.05 off the previous European Championships record, claiming the top seed out of the morning session. Doing it in heats, not the final, is the kind of statement that sets a tone for an entire meet.

newsItems.title: Pan Pacs preview: USA looks to close a historic summer
newsItems.body: Team USA heads into the 2026 Pan Pacific Championships riding serious momentum, with Gretchen Walsh entering as the world record holder in two events. It could be a fitting exclamation point on what has already been a remarkable summer of American swimming.

newsItems.title: Grousset faces a tough title defense in the 50 fly
newsItems.body: World Champion Maxime Grousset returns to competition after a disrupted training cycle caused by a foot injury, stepping into the 50 butterfly against rivals who have been getting faster in his absence. Defending a world title under those conditions is a storyline worth watching all week.

newsItems.title: 13-year-old drops 3 seconds, cracks all-time age group list
newsItems.body: Jett Hatchard, just 13 years old, swam a 2:05.69 in the 200 backstroke at the 2026 Utah Senior Championships, dropping three seconds from his personal best and moving to No. 25 all-time in the boys 13-14 age group. Keep that name somewhere you can find it later.

athlete.name: Leon Marchand
athlete.photoCredit: Photo: Tanis Coralee Leonhardi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
athlete.bio:
Leon Marchand is a French competitive swimmer born on 17 May 2002 in Toulouse, France. He is the son of former medley swimmers Xavier Marchand and Céline Bonnet. He began swimming at age six, later moved to the United States to train with coach Bob Bowman, and swam for Arizona State University while majoring in computer science.

Marchand holds world records in the long course 200 and 400 metres individual medley and the short course 200 metres individual medley. At the 2024 Summer Olympics, he won four individual gold medals in the 200 metre medley, 400 metre medley, 200 metre butterfly, and 200 metre breaststroke, becoming the fourth swimmer in Olympic history to achieve that feat at a single Games. He also won multiple NCAA titles across three championships.
